baseline_kernel: same-source DeepGEMM fp8_m_grouped_gemm_nt_masked BM128 with packed int32 UE8M0 scales, PDL enabled, and fixed SM/TC-util state

bottleneck.evidence: Exact generated SASS showed stock BM128 drained 32 LDTM fragments while BM16 drained 4; balanced Nsys graph launches then measured W13 p50 145.744 to 139.168 us and full device span 226.176 to 218.816 us.

approaches.summary: Built clean stock and candidate DSOs with identical commands, hidden C++ visibility, Bsymbolic, private cache roots, and frozen runtime state.
approaches.why: It closed JIT context interposition and denominator fairness but is a reproducibility prerequisite rather than the optimization itself.

approaches.summary: Instantiated genuine one-CTA group-1 UMMA at config (16,128,128,11,1) for every expected-M key.
approaches.why: Despite exact correctness and removing cooperative barriers, every expected-M probe had at least one required estimator below 1.03.

approaches.summary: Retained cooperative group-2 UMMA while reducing masked-M MMA, TMEM drain, and store granularity with config (16,128,128,12,2).
approaches.why: All 16 local leaf/region eager/graph lanes passed, but checkpoint-backed TP8/DP8/EP8 full-server acceptance remains unrun, so production enablement is intentionally withheld.

lesson: For tiny active-M SM100 masked grouped GEMMs, preserve the mature cooperative pipeline and first reduce the padded accumulator/drain surface; removing two-SM cooperation can lose more than it saves. Side-by-side JIT fairness also requires ELF-level static isolation, not merely separate package and cache names.
transfers_to: packed-UE8M0 grouped MoE decode kernels on sm_100
small-active-M tcgen05 kernels with large caller-owned output slabs
same-process stock/candidate JIT libraries with process-global C++ statics
caveats: The recorded 1.041566 geomean is the geometric mean of the 16 serving-native pooled lane estimates, each from its persisted result JSON; it is not a frozen synthetic-task score.
The local results were source-hash bound but recorded dirty kernel-harness and SGLang git status; the exact measured sources were committed afterward.
TP8 checkpoint accuracy, full dispatch/combine overlap, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, and maximum-rank latency were not run, so the production default remains stock.
